generator: Signal Desk deploy mission (OpenCode / Big Pickle)

services.name: glance
services.notes: Existing user dashboard. Serving the new MY APPS page. Docker build from this repo.

services.name: signal-rsshub
services.notes: Stateless, in-memory cache (no Redis). ACCESS_KEY set to restrict protected routes. Avoid Chromium/Playwright routes on 512 MB.

services.name: signal-apprise
services.notes: Stateless (no durable config), attachments disabled, one worker, strict mode. Free egress cannot use SMTP; use HTTPS notification channels.

services.name: signal-bentopdf
services.notes: Client-side only; files never touch the server. COOP/COEP enable LibreOffice WASM (Office -> PDF). Some advanced engines load from jsDelivr at runtime.

services.name: signal-cyberchef
services.notes: Client-side only. Keep current: a URL-recipe ReDoS was fixed in v11.3.0 (2026-08).

services.name: signal-vert
services.build_command: curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash && export PATH=$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH && bun install && bun run build
services.notes: Client-side conversion. PUB_DISABLE_ALL_EXTERNAL_REQUESTS=true means no vertd calls; vertd-dependent video conversions are intentionally unavailable (per research plan). No secrets in the PUB_* values (all client-side/browser-visible).

resource_budget.model: monthly hours ~= active time + 0.25h x number of isolated wake periods
assumptions: RSSHub: wakes during the Glance session for feed fetches; separate isolated activations add a ~15 min tail each
Apprise: wakes only on notification API calls (personal volume, low)
No uptime monitor, keep-alive script, or cross-service polling is configured
resource_budget.estimate_hours_per_month: well under 100 of 750 in realistic use
resource_budget.build_minutes: Free static builds consume workspace build-pipeline minutes; static sites are set to not auto-deploy on upstream commits to avoid needless rebuilds

security.glance: Public, unauthenticated by design; contains only public URLs and no secrets.
security.secrets_management: App secrets live only in Render env vars (ACCESS_KEY, APPRISE_PASSWORD). Not in Git. See the workspace secret store referenced by the mission.
security.static_sites: No server-side storage; processing is in the visitor's browser.
security.apprise_auth: Basic auth mandatory; verified 401 without credentials.
security.service_ids: Render service IDs are not credentials; they only navigate the owner's authenticated dashboard.

known_limitations: Free web services sleep after ~15 min idle and cold-start in up to ~1 min; a sleeping app is not unhealthy.
RSSHub routes have widely varying dependencies; heavy routes requiring Chromium/Playwright are not reliable on 512 MB.
Apprise cannot send email directly (Render blocks outbound SMTP); use HTTPS channels.
VERT vertd-dependent (server-side) video conversions are disabled by design.
Free service filesystems are ephemeral; none of these apps store irreplaceable data server-side (correct for Free tier).

recreate.blueprint: render.yaml (repo root) — validated with `render blueprints validate render.yaml` (valid=true).
steps: 1. In the target workspace, create a Blueprint from https://github.com/Mr-shubham-kumar/glance (render.yaml at root).
2. Supply the two sync:false secrets when prompted.
3. The five external repos build from their upstream branches listed above.
4. Re-apply BentoPDF response headers if the Blueprint is not used (Render API PUT /v1/services/{id}/headers).
